title: 2022 DAO FALLACIES
abstract: DAO myths are a natural by-product of technological evolution. The paper debunks the top five DAO myths and explores the top five DAO benefits and use cases. Key Words: Decentralized Autonomous Organization, Digital Assets, Valuation, Blockchain, Myth, Uses, Distributed Ledger Technology, Emerging Technology JEL Categories: K20, K23, K32, L43, L5, O31, O3 * (c) 2022 Professor of Law, University of St. Thomas School of Law (Minneapolis, USA). 1 Electronic copy available at: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783 DAO FALLACIES
